sources.seats_and_government: https://parlgov.fly.dev/data/elections/cze/2021-10-09/ and https://parlgov.fly.dev/data/cabinets/cze/2021-12-17/ (Fiala cabinet); individual seat breakdown within the SPOLU and PirStan joint lists (which ParlGov reports only as combined totals) cross-checked via web search (Statista, Who Governs Europe)

parties.party_name: Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party

note: ODS, KDU-ČSL and TOP 09 contested as the joint 'SPOLU' list (71 seats combined, per ParlGov); STAN and the Pirates contested as the joint 'PirStan' list (37 seats combined, per ParlGov). Individual per-party seat counts within each joint list (used here) were not broken out by ParlGov itself and were cross-checked via web search. Fiala government (confirmed via ParlGov cabinet-parties) = all five of these parties (ODS+KDU-ČSL+TOP09+STAN+Piráti); ANO and SPD in opposition.
